# jamfplatform_pro_macos_configuration_profile (List Resource)

Lists macOS configuration profiles. Classic has no RSQL — supply an optional case-insensitive `name_substring` filter applied client-side. List entries surface as identity-only; full profile detail requires a per-profile read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "jamfplatform_pro_macos_configuration_profile" "pppc" {
  config {
    filter = {
      name_substring = "PPPC"
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Attributes) Optional client-side filter for classic-API list operations. Applied after the full list is fetched (classic endpoints do not accept query parameters). Use the singular `by name` data source for exact-name lookup. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter))

### Nested Schema for `filter`

Optional:
